newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cirrus Logic estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cirrus Logic estimate cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Thursday it had lowered its Fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Cirrus Logic Inc to $0.30 a share from $0.40.
-- said it remains neutral on the stock.
-- Gruntal introduced an estimate for fiscal 1998 earnings of $0.75 a share.
-- Gruntal said the company continues to recover and is maintaining its profitability, but it remains to be seen if its new products will be embraced by the marketplace.
-- Cirrus provides large-scale integration products used in high-performance computer systems.
